notes: Improved: Ronin moves like a swordsman: calm and deliberate, circling at a set distance and only stepping in or out when he has to, with no twitchy weaving.; Ronin's cuts are sharper and a bit dimmer: thin pointed lines with a neon edge. In Thousand Cuts he really cuts through the enemy on each pass and ends on the far side, and the cuts stay on the enemy and stream along behind it as it moves, with a hit spark on the enemy itself. The ultimate is much quieter.; 12 more abilities stronger: Lightning, Wind, Poison, Clone, Devil, Angel, Phoenix, Reaper, Titan, Nova, Drake and Instinct. The arrows were re-tuned.
